SELECT "id", "receipt_number", "po_id", "supplier_id", "status", "received_date", "total_amount", "warehouse", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:receipts}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("receipt_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("warehouse"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("notes"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'receipt_number' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "receipt_number" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'receipt_number' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "receipt_number" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'received_date' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "received_date" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'received_date' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "received_date" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_amount' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "total_amount" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_amount' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "total_amount" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'warehouse' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "warehouse" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'warehouse' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "warehouse" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "receipt_number", "po_id", "supplier_id", "status", "received_date", "total_amount", "warehouse", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:receipts}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:receipts}} ("receipt_number", "po_id", "supplier_id", "status", "received_date", "total_amount", "warehouse", "notes", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::int, $4::text, $5::date, $6::numeric, $7::text, $8::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "receipt_number", "po_id", "supplier_id", "status", "received_date", "total_amount", "warehouse", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:receipts}}
SET "receipt_number" = $2::text, "po_id" = $3::int, "supplier_id" = $4::int, "status" = $5::text, "received_date" = $6::date, "total_amount" = $7::numeric, "warehouse" = $8::text, "notes" = $9::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "receipt_number", "po_id", "supplier_id", "status", "received_date", "total_amount", "warehouse", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:receipts}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:receipts}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:receipts}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
